case_name: Ajay Kumar S/O Shri Gangadhar By Caste ... vs Sarita Devi D/O Shri Mahipal@ Maniram By ...

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Ajay Kumar S/o Shri Gangadhar — husband
parties.respondent_defendant: Sarita Devi D/o Shri Mahipal@ Maniram — wife

legal_principles.principle: A petition for divorce under Section 13(1)(ia) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 is maintainable only if there has been no respite in the conduct of the respondent.
legal_principles.held: It is settled law that a petition for divorce under Section 13(1)(ia) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 is maintainable only if there has been no respite in the conduct of the respondent.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the petitioner to prove that there has been no respite in the conduct of the respondent.
legal_principles.held: The burden lies on the petitioner to prove that there has been no respite in the conduct of the respondent.

outcome.final_order: Learned counsel for the appellant seeks time to file reply to the application under Section 24 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. List again on 02.03.2021.
